question: Should the exploited vulnerability be patched now or in the scheduled window?
context: Policy P2 requires critical vulnerabilities that are being exploited to be patched within 72 hours of disclosure. Emergency changes need approval from the change board.

evidence.text: The vulnerability was disclosed 30 hours ago and exploitation is confirmed.
The next scheduled maintenance window is in five days.
The change board can approve an emergency change within four hours.

fields.name: approval
fields.description: is board approval obtained before patching
